grenen.name: Grenen
grenen.slogan: One foot in each sea, at the very tip of Denmark.
grenen.line: At Skagen's sandy tip, the Skagerrak and the Kattegat meet and have built a curved sandbar about 4 km long.

skagensmuseum.name: Skagens Museum
skagensmuseum.slogan: The northern light that Krøyer and the Anchers could not stop painting.
skagensmuseum.line: The museum was founded on 20 October 1908 in the dining room of Brøndums Hotel.

utzoncenter.name: Utzon Center
utzoncenter.slogan: Sydney's architect came home to Aalborg's waterfront.
utzoncenter.line: It was the last building designed by Jørn Utzon, completed in 2008, the year he died.

rubjergknude.name: Rubjerg Knude Lighthouse
rubjergknude.slogan: The tower that rolled away from the sea.
rubjergknude.line: In October 2019 the 23-metre lighthouse was moved about 70 metres inland on rails to escape the eroding cliff.

lindholmhoje.name: Lindholm Høje
lindholmhoje.slogan: A hilltop of stone ships, sailing nowhere for a thousand years.
lindholmhoje.line: The burial ground holds roughly 700 graves, many marked by ship-shaped stone settings, from the Iron and Viking Ages.
